- [ ] **Verifiable** — someone can answer yes or no without arguing about definitions
- [ ] **Placed deliberately** — correct area number, correct maturity level
- [ ] **Consistent** — follows the structure of the surrounding file
- [ ] Structural changes were discussed in an issue first
